# Where retail's placeSpawnpoint puts every spawnpoint a stock gametype
# drops, to the float's last bit, on every stock map of each of the three
# Linux servers. Taken 2026-10-19 (mp_carentan's team deathmatch points first
# that day, the rest the same evening) with
# crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/probe_placebits.gsc as the
# gametype, one map at a time:
#   tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_placebits <map>
#   (COD_VERSION=1.5 and COD_VERSION=uo for the other two; 1.5b and UO with
#   COD_DIR at a 1.5 main/ holding only the stock paks, UO's uo/ beside it)
# A `PROBE class <classname> <count>` line heads each spawn class the map
# carries. Each placebits line: entity number, x, y, z as %g, then z's sign,
# whole part and fraction in 2^-24ths, and for |z| < 1 the next 24 bits.
# UO's mp_cassino ends in a script error from _tankdrive_gmi.gsc after the
# last line (a tank's damage thread reads level.ceasefire, which the probe
# never sets); every spawn class was logged before it.
# Read by crates/server/tests/placespawn_ab.rs.
